id.description: The id a notifier entry names it by in `canoa.cfg`: 1 to 32 lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `_`.

help.description: A line saying where it sends notices and what that service sees of them.

events.description: The event ids it takes; none takes any.

replies.description: Whether the person can answer a notice through it, which [`Notifier::reply`] then takes.

schema.description: The settings it takes, as a guatiao schema of an object; a sensitive member is kept by the host as a secret.

form.description: How the schema is shown, as a guatiao-intake form document; none shows the form the schema implies.

settings.description: The notifier entry's settings as a JSON object keyed by the schema's members, a sensitive member resolved from the host's secret.

id.description: The host's id for this notice, unique among the ones it sent.

event.description: The event it is for: a word of lower-case letters, digits and `_` (`permission`, `finished`, `host_restarted`).

title.description: One line: who it is about and what happened.

body.description: One line: the event's fixed phrase, with the figures it carries.

id.description: The id the host and the application know the session by.

title.description: The session's title as the person or the agent gave it, when it has one.

session.description: The session it is about, when it is about one.

x-enum-labels.low: Something that happened on the host itself.
x-enum-labels.normal: A turn finished, a limit is near, an update failed.
x-enum-labels.high: The person is needed: an approval, a question, a failure, a limit reached.

at.description: When it happened, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

id.description: The id the answer is returned by.

label.description: What the person reads on the button.

actions.description: What the person may answer with. Only the host sets it, for an approval; a notifier that takes no replies ignores it.

nonce.description: An unguessable value an answer carries back, so nothing else can answer for the person.

reply.description: Where an answer is matched to the notice; set with `actions`.
